ContactQuests

沉浸式物流與任務整合 | Immersive Logistics & Questing Integration

 

🇺🇸 English

ContactQuests is a bridge mod that creates a deep integration between [Contact] (Logistics/Mail) and [FTB Quests].

Unlike traditional quests where items are instantly detected in your inventory, ContactQuests requires players to engage with the physical world of logistics. It transforms the abstract concept of "Quest Submission" into an immersive gameplay loop involving packaging, mailing, and waiting for deliveries.

🧩 Key Features

  • Immersive Questing: Move beyond simple "checkmarks." Submit quest items by physically mailing packages to specific NPCs via Mailboxes.

  • New Task Types:

    • 📦 Parcel Task: Pack required items and send them to the target NPC.

    • 📨 Postcard Task: Write and send postcards with specific content or styles.

    • 🧧 Red Packet Task: Send currency or items via Red Packets.

  • Postal Rewards: Rewards aren't just clicked; they arrive at your doorstep! Receive quest rewards as parcels delivered directly to your mailbox.

  • Team Integration: Seamless support for FTB Teams. Use the Team Binding Card to ensure rewards are delivered to your team's shared mailbox.

  • NPC Interaction System: Define custom responses when players send incorrect or extra items. Create NPCs with personality who can reject mail, confiscate items, or send easter egg replies.

📚 Documentation & Wiki

Detailed guides are available on our GitHub Wiki:

  • Getting Started: How to bind mailboxes and complete your first delivery quest.

  • Tasks & Rewards Mechanics: Detailed breakdown of new task types and reward configurations.

  • Configuration Guide: Global settings and setting up delivery delays.

  • NPC Interaction Config: How to configure npc_config.json for custom reply logic.

  • Commands & Permissions: Usage of mod commands.

  • Advanced Quest Logic: Configuring mutex tasks and tag requirements.

  • KubeJS Integration: Scripting support for custom logistics events.

🇹🇼 中文介紹

ContactQuests 是一個旨在實現 [Contact] (郵件/物流) 與 [FTB Quests] (任務) 深度聯動的模組。

本模組打破了傳統任務「點擊即完成」的抽象模式，將任務流程與實體物流緊密結合。它讓玩家必須透過真實的打包、投遞和等待收件來推進任務進度，為整合包帶來更具沉浸感的「敘事」體驗。

🧩 核心特性

  • 沉浸式任務體驗：告別單純的物品檢測。你需要將任務物品打包，並透過郵筒寄送給指定的 NPC 來完成任務。

  • 全新的任務類型：

    • 📦 郵遞任務 (Parcel Task)：將所需物品打包並寄往指定收件人。

    • 📨 明信片任務 (Postcard Task)：向 NPC 寄送特定內容或樣式的明信片。

    • 🧧 紅包任務 (Red Packet Task)：透過紅包寄送指定的物品。

  • 物流獎勵系統：獎勵不再憑空出現！完成任務後，獎勵將以包裹的形式由物流系統派送到你的信箱中。

  • 團隊無縫協作：完美支援 FTB Teams 隊伍系統。使用 團隊綁定器 (Team Binding Card) 將信箱與隊伍綁定，確保以隊伍為單位收到任務獎勵。

  • NPC 互動系統：高度可配置的 NPC 智慧回饋。當玩家寄錯物品時，NPC 可以根據配置做出拒收、沒收甚至觸發彩蛋回覆等反應。

📚 文件與維基

詳細的教學文件請查閱 GitHub Wiki：

  • 快速入門：如何綁定隊伍信箱以及完成你的第一個物流任務。

  • 任務與獎勵詳解：各種新任務類型（郵遞、明信片、紅包）的詳細說明。

  • 設定檔指南：通用設定與物流延遲機制的配置。

  • NPC 互動配置：如何編寫 npc_config.json 來自定義 NPC 的回信邏輯。

  • 指令與權限：模組指令的使用說明。

  • KubeJS 聯動：使用腳本自定義物流事件。
